title.en: The creator believes travel companies like Airbnb are likely to benefit from travel consumption driven by stimulus.
title.zh: 作者认为Airbnb等旅行公司可能受益于刺激政策推动的旅游消费。

title.en: The creator believes speculative companies like Robinhood are likely to benefit from increased consumer capital and investment activity.
title.zh: 作者认为Robinhood等投机性公司可能受益于消费者资金增加带来的投资活跃度。

title.en: The creator believes speculative companies like DraftKings are likely to benefit from increased consumer capital and investment activity.
title.zh: 作者认为DraftKings等投机性公司可能受益于消费者资金增加带来的投资活跃度。

title.en: Believes the company is a potential beneficiary.
title.zh: 认为该公司是潜在的受益者。

title.en: The author believes that if stimulus policies are implemented, the company's sales and profits are likely to increase alongside macroeconomic activity.
title.zh: 作者认为，若刺激计划实施，该公司的销售额和利润可能随宏观经济活动增加而增长。

title.en: The author believes that if stimulus policies are implemented, the company's sales and profits are likely to increase alongside macroeconomic activity.
title.zh: 作者认为，若刺激计划实施，该公司的销售额和利润可能随宏观经济活动增加而增长。

title.en: The author cites Piper Sandler's analysis, noting the bull case for AMD driven by AI demand.
title.zh: 作者引用 Piper Sandler 的分析，看好 AMD 因 AI 需求带来的增长。

title.en: The author believes Wall Street analysts will continue upgrading AMD and expects the stock to exceed $1,000 per share.
title.zh: 作者认为华尔街分析师将持续上调 AMD 评级，预期股价将突破 1000 美元。

title.en: The creator believes AMD will continue to move higher, its business will grow exponentially over the next few years, and it is on the way to $1,000+ per share.
title.zh: 作者认为AMD将持续上涨，业务将在未来几年内指数级增长，目标价为1000美元以上。

title.en: The creator states a personal return target of 15%, finds the current Nike stock price attractive within their assumptions, and expresses interest in buying.
title.zh: 作者表示个人回报率目标为15%，当前Nike股价在其假设范围内，因此有兴趣买入。

title.en: The creator believes Tesla's Cyber Cab strategy has promise and that 350 dollars is still attractive.
title.zh: 作者认为特斯拉的Cyber Cab策略有前景，目前350美元价位仍有吸引力。

title.en: The creator argues that users will leave Uber when they find a better product or service. He criticizes the drivers and subcontracted service experience, while saying this discussion is not aimed at Uber as a company or its stock.
title.zh: 作者认为，一旦找到更好的产品或服务，用户就会离开 Uber。他批评的是司机及分包服务体验，并明确表示这段讨论并非针对 Uber 公司或股票。

title.en: The creator sees a further small Tesla pullback as a more attractive entry; he also sees appeal around the stated $350 price if his Cybercab thesis is right.
title.zh: 博主认为，特斯拉若再小幅回落，会带来更有吸引力的入场价；即使股价约为350美元，只要其Cybercab战略判断成立，也有吸引力。

title.en: Users will dump Uber like a hot potato, but not targeting the company or drivers.
title.zh: 用户会像扔热土豆一样抛弃Uber，但不针对公司本身或司机抱怨。

title.en: The speaker believes a Tesla price drop below $350 could be an attractive entry point.
title.zh: 演讲者认为特斯拉股价下跌至350美元以下可能是一个更吸引人的入场点。

title.en: AMD is crucial for semiconductor buildout.
title.zh: AMD是半导体建仓的关键公司。

title.en: NVIDIA is still a big player.
title.zh: NVIDIA仍是重要玩家。

title.en: The creator says roughly half of Oracle’s orders depend on OpenAI. He expects interest in OpenAI to rise after its release and ease concerns about Oracle.

title.en: The creator believes Google will remain competitive and that Gemini 4 could deliver a qualitative improvement.
title.zh: 作者认为谷歌不会落后，Gemini 4可能带来质的提升。
